reason: Worker-backed GUI panes stayed in error after an idle project's worker retired and was readmitted, until a reload. Core now answers project reads without a ready worker with a coded, retryable 503 (project_runtime_unavailable + reason starting/closing/idle, Retry-After: 1) and the UI waits for the runtime instead of failing: one shared probe, every pane re-reads in place, one calm status line. Selected: test_api_worker.py (the coded 503 for each reason and the unchanged body for other private-channel failures, plus the existing API-worker contract), test_runtime_routing.py (the new idle/starting/closing reasons and the existing routing cases), test_runtime_http.py (the proxy codes only project reads; the host channel keeps its body), test_execution_worker.py except the flaky idle-probe case (a starting worker's coded 503, failed/fenced gates, the existing worker lifecycle), the playwright-impact manifest checks that pass on main (the catalog gained an area), the new and changed vitest suites for the recovery module, client, panes, workspace collections and subagents, plus existing suites around the changed client send path and app shell, and the new real-Core journey on desktop, Chromium 390 and WebKit 390. The journey now sets the fixture's idle grace to 0 (a test-fixture control only): since #1062 a quiet project's worker stays 300 s after its last command, and the journey's archive is such a command.
exclusions: Excluded because they fail on pristine origin/main: test_execution_worker.py::test_idle_worker_makes_no_fenced_claims_and_still_picks_up_work (flaky: 1 of 4 runs on main and 1 of 3 on this branch fail on a FOR SHARE statement in the idle window), tests/test_playwright_impact.py::test_full_manifest_covers_every_product_browser_spec_without_filters, and ui/src/api/client.test.ts (3 resolveReceipt cases fail on main; the ui-receipts agent owns them). test_runtime_work_batch_integration.py is unchanged in the final diff. The other five runtime-pane-recovery catalog entries (compact, Chromium/WebKit 320 and 430) are catalogued but not selected to bound real-Core cost; the scratch LAN runs covered desktop Chromium 1440 and WebKit iPhone 13 390. The real-Core journey could not complete locally because the fixture's worker starts time out on this host (load ~40): its calm idle state, no alerts, axe and hit-test assertions passed on desktop before readmission exceeded 120 s.
